title: Childhood and school
body: Learned to walk early and never really stopped. Long walks are still where most of my ideas show up, usually right after I've left my notebook at home.

title: Started a BSc at East West University
BSc in Computer Science & Engineering · East West University
body: Graduated, majoring in software engineering, with research in machine learning.

title: Junior Software Engineer · Sheba Technologies
body: Built the learning platforms for BRAC, one of the world's largest NGOs: BRAC Career Hub, Shikkhasheba, the BRAC Institute of Skills Development and the BRAC Educational Platform. Built a touchless attendance system's admin panel from scratch, and introduced TypeScript across the codebase.

title: Paper presented · IEEE ICIRCA 2022
body: First author, on recognising Bangla handwritten characters. Presented in Coimbatore, India.
